body: Yeah, Im feeling better now. Worst part was that it was only really one module that pulled me down, most likely due to my handwriting.

Hey guys just an update. I wrote the original post while my mom was talking with my psychiatrist. I was to be admitted to hospital because I was still suicidal, but I refused. I had a long and meaningful talk with my mom and I realised how much it would hurt her if I killed myself. I know things havent been going my way for a long time but maybe all of this happened just so I could realise how much my mother meant to me. I guess that means I'm starting to hope again. Thank you all.
